Iowa late-stage lung cancer and social need

CAMSA lung cancer estimates (2016-2020) and CMS social-determinant measures (2020), by ZCTA and census tract. Hover for a value; click for all values.
Rates: CAMSA small-area estimates (smoothed). Tract rates are borrowed from the ZCTAs each tract overlaps. SDOH: CMS Office of Minority Health, Mapping Medicare Disparities, SDOH View (2020). Clusters: local Moran's I, 999 permutations, p < 0.05. Draft for planning.
